content:
開發者由即日起可以提交專為 iOS 27 及 Apple 其他全新作業系統而設計的應用程式，相關系統將於下星期一正式推出。以下是今次更新的詳情。

Developers can submit apps built for iOS 27

Apple yesterday confirmed at its "Surf and Shine" event that iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS 27, tvOS 27, visionOS 27, and watchOS 27 will officially debut next Monday, September 14.

Apple today announced that developers can immediately download Xcode 27 Release Candidate and submit apps and games built with the latest SDKs for review.

Apple also took the opportunity to remind developers that macOS 27 will only support software built specifically for Apple silicon:

Additionally, Apple reminded developers to answer the new age rating questions, as these apply to features like Screen Time. Apple also encouraged developers to prepare new header designs and search result assets for their App Store product pages, and provided the latest design guidelines and templates to help them create product pages, screenshots, app previews, and in-app event content.

Finally, Apple reiterated once again that "starting April 2027, apps and games uploaded to App Store Connect must meet the following minimum requirements":

  • iOS and iPadOS apps must be built with iOS 27 and iPadOS 27 SDKs or later
  • tvOS apps must be built with the tvOS 27 SDK or later
  • visionOS apps must be built with the visionOS 27 SDK or later
  • watchOS apps must be built with the watchOS 27 SDK or later

To read Apple's full blog post on the Developer website, click this link.
